Shift Count & Schedule Configurations

            
Configure how many shifts are operating. Adding a shift creates a default M-F schedule; reducing removes the highest shift number.

          

          

            
            

              
              2
              
            

          

        

        

          

            
Shift start dates

            
Leave blank if the shift runs all year. Before its start date a shift makes no units and its crew isn't paid. Individual lines can use a different date on page 3.

          

          

        

        

      

    


    
    

      
      

        

          

            
Labor Allocation — Labor Stages

            
Each position's labor is charged to one of these stages. Machines still make Stage 1 or Stage 2 units, but every labor stage's cost is divided by total units (= Stage 1 units, since Stage 2/3 work modifies those same units). The stage costs add up to the overall Labor $ / Unit.

          

          
        

        

          

            
Labor Stages

            

          

          

            
"Match Line's Stage" Positions

            
Positions set to Match line's stage are charged by the machine's stage (page 3). For example, an Operator on a Stage 1 line counts as Stage 1 labor; on a Stage 2 line, as Stage 2.

Manufacturing Lines & Stage Processing

            
Stage 1 lines produce base units. Stage 2 lines process Stage 1 units. Packaging Only and Non Production lines are labor-only cost centers (no units, but their labor counts in all totals). Assign line schedules, shift downtime %, scrap %, and dropdown position requirements.

          

          

            
            
          
          

        

        

      

    


    
    

      

        

          

            
Employee Slot Roster

            
Slots are generated based on manufacturing line shift requirements. Employee names are optional; labor costs and production income calculate regardless.

            
Drag the ⠿ handle to reorder employees. To move someone to another line, drag them over that line and hold for a moment until it turns green, then release.

Inventory Days

            
Choose the date range for inventory, then check the machines, shifts and positions that will run. On inventory days only the checked positions are paid (their normal shift hours, weekends included). Everyone else is off. Paid holidays inside the range stay holidays.

Labor $ / Unit Threshold

            
Set the most labor you want to spend per unit. When the full-year plan is over it, every page shows a warning, the over-limit numbers turn red, and the lines get suggested headcount cuts. Uses total units (= Stage 1 units) and the labor cost basis below.

Plant-Wide Labor & Compensation Rules

          
Configure cost of living wage increases, weekly overtime thresholds, and paid holiday hours credit.

        


        

          
          

            

              
              
Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA)

            

            

              
              
              Defaulted to July 1st of planning year. Wages increase by COLA % starting on and after this date.
            

            

              
              
              Across-the-board percentage bump applied to slot wages.
            

          


          
          

            

              
              
Overtime Premium Policies

            

            

              
              
              Standard premium multiplier (e.g. 1.5x).
            

            

              
              
            

            

              
              
              Weekly mode: hours per work week (e.g. 40). Daily mode: hours per day (e.g. 8).
            

            

              
              
              Weekly overtime accumulates within this fixed 7-day window.
            

            

              
              When checked, does not apply overtime to holiday hours.
            

          


          
          

            

              
              
Holiday Pay & Plant Closures

            

            

              
              
              Paid hours credited to each slot for every holiday.
            

            

              
Policy Summary:

              
• COLA effective 07-01-2026.

              
• Overtime threshold: 40h (WEEKLY) at 1.5x.

              
• Working Hours Only OT: Enabled.

              
• Holiday credit: 8h.

              
• Pay period: 14 days.

            

          

        

      


      
      

        

          
Paid Time Off & Sick Leave

          
Paid hours off for personal time and sick leave. Both are paid at each employee's wage (including COLA) and never count toward overtime. Each employee's hours show on page 4.

        

        

          
When someone is out on personal or sick time

          

        

        

          

            
Personal Time

            
            
            
PTO / vacation. The default for every employee; individual employees can be changed on page 4.

            

          

          

            

              
Virginia Earned Paid Sick Leave

                Va. Code § 40.1-33.6:2

              
            

            

              

                
                
              

              

                
                
              

              

                
                
              

              

                
                
hrs worked

              

              

                
                
              

              

                
                
%

              

            

            
            

            
From the statute: at least 1 hour for every 30 hours worked, starting at hire; employers may cap accrual and use at 40 hours a year (or give more); front-loading 40 hours at the start of the year satisfies the law; unused hours carry over but are not paid out at separation. Start dates by employer size (2026 Acts cc. 1128/1129): 50+ employees July 1, 2027; 25–49 January 1, 2028; 1–24 January 1, 2029. Not legal advice: confirm coverage and details with counsel or the Virginia Department of Labor and Industry.

Totals Report Section 2A: Monthly Labor & Output Breakdown

          
Labor basis: Direct labor. Each month's labor is the work done in that month (change on page 6).

          
Splits net good units between Stage 1 and Stage 2, with Daily Box Goal showing average Stage 1 units per production day (No Production days pay labor but make no units). Monthly spend is broken into regular hours (straight time + paid holiday hours) and overtime hours (paid at the OT multiplier); Regular + Overtime = Total. Labor $/Unit = total spend (all stages) ÷ Stage 1 units.
